Release · 22 Sep 2026

VLC 3.0.24 closes more than 130 security holes and moves to FFmpeg 8.1.

The twenty-fifth update of the “Vetinari” branch refreshes 49 libraries, adds ATRAC3, ATRAC9 and CEA-708 captions in MP4, and makes Windows start faster when the clocks change.

VLC 3.0.24 is a major security update, with over 130 security fixes across VLC and its bundled libraries. It upgrades FFmpeg from 4.4 to 8.1.2 and updates 49 third-party libraries. New features include ATRAC decoding, CEA-708 captions in MP4, SRT listener mode and NV12 DirectShow capture on Windows. This release also fixes slow Windows startup when Daylight Saving Time changes and a MIDI playback crash on macOS 26 and later. More details on the release page. Security advisories will be updated a few days after the release.

A letter to our readers

VLC has never shown you an ad. It never will.

VLC is made by volunteers and run by VideoLAN, a small non-profit under French law. There are no investors to please and no data to sell. What keeps the cone turning is people: developers who give their evenings, translators, testers, and readers who chip in for servers, test hardware and meetings like VideoLAN Dev Days.

If VLC has played something for you that nothing else would, consider returning the favour. It takes a moment: Apple Pay, Google Pay, card, SEPA, PayPal, bank transfer or Bitcoin.

— The VideoLAN volunteers

Or give your time →
